## Change

Describe the behavior, price evidence, or documentation updated.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] Affected calculations or interface behavior have tests.
- [ ] Price changes cite official sources, dated observations, and tax interpretation.
- [ ] No missing prices are replaced by assumptions, conversions, or zero-valued placeholders.

## Notes

Document any remaining limitations relevant to reviewers and downstream consumers.
